planName: Hardening, Portability, and DX Improvements for Swarm Coder
summary: Harden Go mechanical enforcement gates against OOM and path bypasses, ensure cross-platform hook portability across macOS and Linux, achieve multi-harness agent instruction parity, add subprocess timeouts and ownership overlap validation to Python orchestration skills, and establish CI quality gates.

components.name: Mechanical Gates (Go)
components.purpose: Enforce strict test-first development (tdd-guard) and policy boundaries (anvil-guard) with memory-safe streaming digests and robust path normalization.

components.name: Orchestration Skills (Python)
components.purpose: Deterministic planning, wave execution, research merging, code review consolidation, and doc standards with timeout protection and ownership overlap detection.

components.name: Harness Adapters & Hooks (Shell / JSON)
components.purpose: Cross-platform shell hooks and agent definitions ensuring uniform capabilities across Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity.

components.name: Repository Standards & CI/CD
components.purpose: Accurate ADRs, synchronized documentation, and automated GitHub Actions verification covering build, lint, format, and docs check.

issues.title: Harden guard mechanical gates with streaming SHA-256 and cross-platform path normalization
issues.body: Resolve unbounded memory consumption in untracked diff digesting by streaming hash computation with an enforced size limit. Fix Linux path normalization for backslash-separated paths in sealed test checks. Cache repository directory walk in arch-check to avoid quadratic filesystem traversals.

acceptanceTests.name: untracked-digest-streaming
acceptanceTests.oracle: Digesting untracked files uses io.Copy with a bounded buffer or streaming hasher without loading full files into memory via os.ReadFile.

acceptanceTests.name: backslash-path-normalization
acceptanceTests.oracle: Paths with literal backslashes on Linux are converted to forward slashes before component splitting and sealed test check.

acceptanceTests.name: arch-check-glob-caching
acceptanceTests.oracle: Arch-check assertions execute against a single pre-walked repository tree cache rather than walking the filesystem per glob assertion.

issues.title: Fix cross-platform hook portability, Antigravity payloads, and tool bootstrap
issues.body: Add jq dependency verification to bootstrap-tools.sh. Fix word-boundary regexes in build-guard to support BSD grep on macOS without bypassing rules. Expand build-format and build-lint to support Antigravity tool-call arguments. Ensure .git/info exists before writing to .git/info/exclude in project-bootstrap.sh.

acceptanceTests.name: bootstrap-jq-dependency
acceptanceTests.oracle: scripts/bootstrap-tools.sh checks and installs jq via brew or apt.

acceptanceTests.name: build-guard-posix-grep
acceptanceTests.oracle: build-guard denies push and commit to main under POSIX/BSD grep without relying on PCRE \b escapes.

acceptanceTests.name: hooks-antigravity-payload
acceptanceTests.oracle: build-format and build-lint correctly extract filepath from Antigravity toolCall payload structures.

acceptanceTests.name: project-bootstrap-git-exclude
acceptanceTests.oracle: project-bootstrap.sh creates .git/info directory if missing before appending ignore patterns.

issues.title: Add subprocess timeouts in GitHub reconciler, wave ownership overlap detection, and fix doc script paths
issues.body: Add default timeout to gh subprocess invocations in reconcile_github.py. Implement programmatic glob overlap detection in waves.py to prevent concurrent builder collisions. Correct all skill markdown files to reference explicit repository-relative script paths.

acceptanceTests.name: reconcile-gh-timeout
acceptanceTests.oracle: reconcile_github.py sets timeout=30 on subprocess.run calls and handles TimeoutExpired cleanly.

acceptanceTests.name: wave-ownership-overlap-detection
acceptanceTests.oracle: waves.py identifies overlapping ownershipHint globs in the same wave and flags or serializes them.

acceptanceTests.name: skill-doc-relative-paths
acceptanceTests.oracle: All script commands in skills/*/SKILL.md reference valid, existing files relative to the repository root.

issues.title: Align agent instructions across Claude, Codex, and Antigravity and wire Antigravity builder hooks
issues.body: Port missing Skills guidelines and role instructions from Claude agent definitions to Codex and Antigravity agents. Wire format, advisory lint, and tdd-guard hooks into agents/agy/builder/hooks.json.

acceptanceTests.name: agent-skills-parity
acceptanceTests.oracle: agents/codex/docs.md and agents/agy/docs/agent.md include full skill guidance matching agents/claude/docs.md.

acceptanceTests.name: antigravity-builder-hooks-json
acceptanceTests.oracle: agents/agy/builder/hooks.json defines valid PreToolUse and PostToolUse hook configurations for guard, format, and lint.

issues.title: Reconcile ADRs with centralized skills layout and add CI quality gates
issues.body: Update ADR-0001 or add ADR-0002 to reflect the centralized skills layout and cross-harness install strategy. Add CI workflow jobs for formatting (gofmt, ruff format), linting (golangci-lint, ruff check, shellcheck), and docs compliance (docs_check.py).

acceptanceTests.name: docs-check-adr-compliance
acceptanceTests.oracle: python3 skills/docs/scripts/docs_check.py passes with 0 errors across all docs/adr/ records.

acceptanceTests.name: ci-workflow-lint-steps
acceptanceTests.oracle: .github/workflows/ci.yml includes automated lint, format, and docs-check execution.
